placement.orientation: upright; tree trunk vertical; snowflakes frame the tree
placement.relativeScale: about 28% of visible front torso width; preserve safe margin from neckline, armholes, and side seams
placement.uvMapping: Map only to the front torso UV island after Designer supplies the UV layout; do not mirror or continue across back/side islands.
placement.validation: Inspect front, oblique, side, and back renders after mapping. Confirm the motif remains legible, follows chest curvature, and does not bleed onto back or sleeves.

dimensions: Artwork viewBox is a normalized vector canvas, not a garment size or print manufacturing measurement.
